import BusyBeaver.ZFC.BinaryPerm252
namespace SetTheory.BusyBeaver.ZFC.BinaryAuditPerm252
open BinaryPerm252

theorem numeric_refutation_halts (h : Code254.C254 Code254.F) :
    ∃ t, (machinePerm252.run t).state = none :=
  blank_halts_iff_c254.mpr h

theorem binary_halting_refutes_native {t : Nat}
    (h : (machinePerm252.run t).state = none) :
    BProv NativeTheory254.NativeAx [] Form.fBot :=
  blank_halts_iff_native_refutation.mp ⟨t, h⟩

theorem native_consistency_excludes_each_halt
    (h : ¬ BProv NativeTheory254.NativeAx [] Form.fBot) :
    ∀ t, (machinePerm252.run t).state ≠ none := by
  intro t ht
  exact h (binary_halting_refutes_native ht)

theorem literal_register_halt_implies_blank_halt
    (h : RegisterPath.Halts Prog254.program Permutation252Frame.zeroRoot) :
    BlankHalts machinePerm252 :=
  blank_halts_iff_register.mpr h

theorem zf_refutation_halts (h : BProv ZFax_s [] Form.fBot) :
    BlankHalts machinePerm252 := blank_halts_iff_zf_refutation.mpr h

theorem actual_blank_halting_refutes_zf (h : BlankHalts machinePerm252) :
    BProv ZFax_s [] Form.fBot := blank_halts_iff_zf_refutation.mp h

theorem accepted_numeric_proof_halts (code : Nat)
    (h : Code254Proof.check code Code254.F = true) : BlankHalts machinePerm252 :=
  blank_halts_iff_checked_refutation.mpr ⟨code, h⟩

theorem no_accepted_proof_excludes_binary_halting
    (h : ¬ ∃ code, Code254Proof.check code Code254.F = true) :
    ¬ BlankHalts machinePerm252 :=
  nonhalting_iff_no_checked_refutation.mpr h

theorem actual_working_state_count : rawTablePerm252.size = 252 := rawTablePerm252_size

theorem actual_total_transition_count :
    (rawTablePerm252.toList.flatMap (fun row => [row.1, row.2])).length = 504 :=
  rawTablePerm252_transition_count

#print axioms accepted_numeric_proof_halts
#print axioms no_accepted_proof_excludes_binary_halting

#print axioms actual_total_transition_count
end SetTheory.BusyBeaver.ZFC.BinaryAuditPerm252

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Run only after the serialized slot and closed Sites certificate are granted."""
import hashlib,json,os,pathlib,re,subprocess,time
ROOT=pathlib.Path('/home/codex/.codex/worktrees/ec20/Proofs')
HERE=pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parent
LEAN=pathlib.Path('/home/codex/.elan/toolchains/leanprover--lean4---v4.32.0/bin/lean')
SOURCE=ROOT/'Computability/BusyBeaver/Lean/BusyBeaver/ZFC/BinaryPerm252.lean'
BASE=pathlib.Path(os.environ['BINARY_VERIFIED_BASE_CACHE'])
OUT=HERE/'cache'
TARGET=OUT/'BusyBeaver/ZFC/BinaryPerm252.olean'
TARGET.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
if not (BASE/'BusyBeaver/ZFC/SitesPerm252.olean').is_file():
    raise SystemExit('No closed Sites object in the explicitly supplied checked cache.')
# Lean resolves a package prefix from one search root; make a real overlay
# with file symlinks, including any private/server sidecars, rather than
# expecting per-module fallthrough across two BusyBeaver package roots.
for folder,_,names in os.walk(BASE,followlinks=True):
    rel=pathlib.Path(folder).relative_to(BASE)
    target_folder=OUT/rel;target_folder.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
    for name in names:
        dest=target_folder/name
        if not dest.exists() and not dest.is_symlink():
            dest.symlink_to((pathlib.Path(folder)/name).resolve())
ENV=os.environ.copy();ENV['LEAN_PATH']=str(OUT)
CWD=ROOT/'Computability/BusyBeaver/Lean'
def digest(p):return hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
record={'status':'RUNNING','scope':'Fresh BinaryPerm252 and ten endpoint/count callers; source-matched dependencies reused, no full closure rebuild.','lean_executable':str(LEAN),'dependency_cache':str(BASE),'source':str(SOURCE),'source_sha256':digest(SOURCE),'audit_source':(HERE/'Audit.lean').read_text(),'checks':[]}
record['lean_version']=subprocess.check_output([str(LEAN),'--version'],cwd=CWD,text=True).strip()
(HERE/'verification.json').write_text(json.dumps(record,indent=2)+'\n')
for label,cmd in [('source',[str(LEAN),'-o',str(TARGET),str(SOURCE)]),('ten_callers',[str(LEAN),str(HERE/'Audit.lean')])]:
    started=time.monotonic()
    with (HERE/(label+'.log')).open('w') as out:
        done=subprocess.run(cmd,cwd=CWD,env=ENV,stdout=out,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
    entry={'kind':label,'command':cmd,'cwd':str(CWD),'LEAN_PATH':ENV['LEAN_PATH'],'elapsed_seconds':time.monotonic()-started,'exit_code':done.returncode,'output':(HERE/(label+'.log')).read_text()}
    record['checks'].append(entry)
    record['status']='INCOMPLETE' if done.returncode else 'RUNNING'
    (HERE/'verification.json').write_text(json.dumps(record,indent=2)+'\n')
    print(json.dumps({k:entry[k] for k in ['kind','elapsed_seconds','exit_code']}),flush=True)
    if done.returncode:raise SystemExit(done.returncode)
if digest(SOURCE)!=record['source_sha256']:
    raise SystemExit('Source changed during checks; no final pass recorded.')
allowed={'propext','Classical.choice','Quot.sound'}
for entry,expected in zip(record['checks'],[13,10]):
    blocks=re.findall(r'depends on axioms: \[([^\]]*)\]',entry['output'])
    no_axioms=entry['output'].count('does not depend on any axioms')
    actual={x.strip() for b in blocks for x in b.split(',') if x.strip()}
    entry['axiom_reports']=len(blocks)+no_axioms
    entry['axiom_names']=sorted(actual)
    if actual-allowed or entry['axiom_reports']!=expected:
        raise SystemExit('Unexpected axiom report set or count; no final pass recorded.')
record['status']='PASS'
record['olean_sha256']=digest(TARGET)
record['audit_sha256']=digest(HERE/'Audit.lean')
(HERE/'verification.json').write_text(json.dumps(record,indent=2)+'\n')
print('PASS',flush=True)
